name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea for this project

### Please describe.

A clear and concise description of what the feature is and your problem that it would address. Ex. I'm always frustrated when [...]

### Describe the solution you'd like

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

### Describe alternatives you've considered

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

### Affected repo surfaces

- [ ] `backend/app`
- [ ] `backend/etl`
- [ ] `frontend/src`
- [ ] Figma, browser harness, or design-system metadata
- [ ] API contract or generated schema (`openapi.json`, `frontend/src/schema.d.ts`)
- [ ] Docs
- [ ] Scripts, CI, or `docker-compose`
- [ ] Unknown

### In scope now

Describe the smallest useful outcome for this request.


### Not in scope

Call out follow-on work, adjacent ideas, or areas that should stay untouched for now.


### Validation or acceptance

How should we know this is complete? Describe the user-visible result, checks, or proof that would make this request done.


### Cross-stack or contract note

Does this likely require new or changed API routes, schemas, generated frontend types, docs, or another repo boundary? If yes, say which ones.

### Additional context

Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request here. It may be a good idea to mention that platform and your Python and Node version you are on.
